player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} odlala umdlalo we-Pig Dice.

Imithetho:
- Ngokwezikhathi zakho, unaweza ukuthi '[roll]' noma '[hold]'
- Gwinya i-2-6: Ongeza ku-tally yakho yezikhathi
- Gwinya i-1: Ulahlekelwa yitally yakho yezikhathi futhi uphela isikhathi
- Hold: Ongeza itally yakho yezikhathi ku-score yakho futhi uphela isikhathi
- Oqala ukufikia {winning_score} amapoyinti uphumelele

Lapho kusezikhathi zakho, uzobona amascore ajwayelekile ne-tally yezikhathi.
Phendula ngokuthi '[roll]' ukurolla idice noma '[hold]' ukuweka amapoyinti akho.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Ifomethi yesenzo engekho emthethweni. Sebenzisa u-"[roll]" noma u-"[hold]".

board.current_total_scores: Amanani aphelele wamanje: {scores} Isamba sakho samanje si-{turn_total}.

outcome.winner_by_turn_limit: Umdlali {winner_id} uwine ngokuba ne-scor ephakeme kumkhawulo we-turn ({scores})
outcome.winner_by_score: Umdlali {winner_id} uwine ngokufinyelela amaphuzu okuhloswe ngawo ka {winning_score}!
outcome.draw: Umkhawulo wokuphenduka ufinyelelwe futhi bonke abadlali banamaphuzu afanayo: {scores}
